recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs.(debug|release)/d ; s/include ".*/include "arm64-v8a"/' -i android/app/build.gradle
wget -q -O /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -- https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.14.0/node-v22.14.0-linux-x64.tar.xz
sha256sum -c <<< '69b09dba5c8dcb05c4e4273a4340db1005abeafe3927efda2bc5b249e80437ec  /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip'
tar xf /tmp/nodejs-lts.zip -C /opt
export PATH="${PATH}:/opt/node-v22.14.0-linux-x64/bin:${HOME}/.node/bin"
npm config set prefix "${HOME}/.node"
npm ci
sed -r '/signingConfigs.debug/d' -i android/app/build.gradle
sed -r '/version/ { s/"[0-9.]+"/"'"${APP_TAG:1}"'"/ }' -i package.json
cd android && chmod +x gradlew && ./gradlew assembleRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mv app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-arm64-v8a-release-unsigned.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
